title: 第285章平等的合作关系
slug: 临时加彩礼转头另娶绝美女知青
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陈卫东带着这二十套衣服，先去了县城供销社。

看到陈卫东这两天送来的衣服数量少了不少，葛洪忍不住冲他念叨道：“今天还是只有二十套衣服啊？

陈同志，你们能不能再多送点？

这么点衣服，完全不够我们卖的。”

之前红旗生产队一天送三四十套衣服过来，他们基本上都能卖掉，更别说二十套衣服了。

原本葛洪以为，红旗生产队制衣厂的衣服火一阵子就不火了。

结果完全出乎了他的意料。

红旗生产队制衣厂的衣服火爆得很！

这几天，来供销社想买成衣的顾客越来越多了。

也因为成衣的火爆，买布料做衣服的人反而少了。

陈卫东听到葛洪的念叨，便有些歉疚地冲葛洪道：“葛主任，实在不好意思，不是我不想多送点衣服给您，而是实在多送不了。

实不相瞒，葛主任，除了和咱们县供销社的合作，我们红旗生产队还和市里的几家供销社也合作了。

我们制衣厂一天只能生产出来四十套衣服，能给您送二十套过来，分了你们一半，已经不少了。

您放心，若是货品足够的话，我们红旗生产队的服装一定会优先供给您这边的。”

陈卫东和葛主任解释原因，一来是告诉他，他们生产队不是存心送少了，避免产生不必要的误会。

二来也是为了让葛主任知道，他们红旗生产队的制衣厂发展得越来越好，以后合作的话，得以一个平等的地位相处。

以前可能是他们生产队求着县城供销社能卖他们的服装，往后就是正常的合作关系了。

葛洪听了陈卫东的解释，这才了然地点了点头，此时看着陈卫东的眼神中也多了几分欣赏。

这小子倒是厉害，竟然和市里的供销社也谈下来了合作，还真不容易。

若是红旗生产队制衣厂生产出来的服装在市里卖的不错，估计他们每天生产的衣服更不够卖的。

想到这儿，葛洪又开始紧张起来了。

真要是有这一天，只怕陈卫东一天二十套衣服都不能给他们提供了吧？

他们少提供一套衣服，他们供销社就得少挣一笔利润。

最近他们县供销社靠着红旗生产队的成衣挣了不少，让葛洪尝到了甜头。

若是往后因为货源的问题少挣了，葛洪心里便觉得惋惜。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Chen Weidong took these twenty sets of clothes and went to the county supply and marketing cooperative first.

Seeing that the number of clothes sent by Chen Weidong had decreased a lot in the past two days, Ge Hong couldn't help but mutter to him: "There are still only twenty sets of clothes today?

Comrade Chen, can you give me more?

Such a small amount of clothes is not enough for us to sell."

In the past, the Hongqi production team sent thirty or forty sets of clothes a day, and they could basically sell them, let alone twenty sets of clothes.

Ge Hong originally thought that the clothes from the Hongqi Production Team Garment Factory would become popular and then stop being popular.

The result was completely beyond his expectation.

The clothes from the Hongqi Production Team Garment Factory are very popular!

In the past few days, more and more customers have come to the supply and marketing cooperative to buy ready-made clothes.

Also because of the popularity of ready-made clothing, fewer people are buying fabrics to make clothes.

When Chen Weidong heard Ge Hong's words, he said to Ge Hong apologetically: "Director Ge, I'm really sorry. It's not that I don't want to give you more clothes, but I really can't give you more.

To be honest, Director Ge, in addition to cooperating with our county supply and marketing cooperative, our Hongqi production team also cooperates with several supply and marketing cooperatives in the city.

Our garment factory can only produce forty sets of clothes a day. We can send you twenty sets, so half of it is divided between you, which is already a lot.

You can rest assured that if there are enough goods, the clothing from our Hongqi production team will be given priority to you."

Chen Weidong and Director Ge explained the reason. First, they told him that their production team did not deliberately send less to avoid unnecessary misunderstandings.

Secondly, it is also to let Director Ge know that the garment factory of their Hongqi Production Team is developing better and better. If they cooperate in the future, they can get along with each other on an equal footing.

In the past, their production team might have begged the county supply and marketing cooperative to sell their clothes, but from now on it will be a normal cooperative relationship.

After hearing Chen Weidong's explanation, Ge Hong nodded clearly. At this time, he looked at Chen Weidong with a little more appreciation in his eyes.

This guy is really awesome. He even negotiated a cooperation with the city's supply and marketing cooperative. It's not easy.

If the clothes produced by the Hongqi Production Team Garment Factory sell well in the city, it is estimated that the clothes they produce every day are not enough to sell.

Thinking of this, Ge Hong became nervous again.

If this day comes, I'm afraid Chen Weidong won't be able to provide them with twenty sets of clothes a day, right?

If they provide one less set of clothes, their supply and marketing cooperative will have to make less profit.

Recently, their county supply and marketing cooperative has made a lot of money from the ready-made clothes of the Hongqi production team, which has given Ge Hong a taste of the benefits.

If he makes less money in the future due to supply problems, Ge Hong will feel regretful in his heart.
